Class NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyTransport

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.netty.NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyTransport
Direct Known Subclasses:
NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyDatagramTransport, NettyPythonEventLoop.NettySocketTransport
Enclosing class:
NettyPythonEventLoop
public abstract static class NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyTransport extends Object
What the Netty-backed stream and datagram transports share: the channel, the protocol, the provider that owns the channel, and the asyncio members that only depend on them.
